senses.en: a container for household rubbish (British English)

example.en: He took the rubbish out to the dustbin.
example.zh: 他把垃圾拿到垃圾箱去。

senses.en: having lost hope or enthusiasm; discouraged

example.en: The team looked dispirited after losing the match.
example.zh: 输掉比赛后，队员们看起来垂头丧气。

senses.en: to keep someone apart from others

example.en: The writer secluded herself in the mountains to finish her novel.
example.zh: 这位作家隐居山中以完成她的小说。

senses.en: a school offering instruction in many technical and applied sciences
senses.zh: 理工学院；工艺专科学校

example.en: She studied engineering at a polytechnic.
example.zh: 她在一所理工学院学习工程学。

senses.en: knowing someone or having knowledge of something

example.en: I got acquainted with my new colleagues last week.
example.zh: 我上周和新同事认识了。

senses.en: things that are done; deeds

example.en: His actions spoke louder than his words.
example.zh: 他的行动胜过言语。

senses.en: one of the joints of a finger, especially where it bends when you make a fist

example.en: He rapped on the door with his knuckles.
example.zh: 他用指节敲门。

collocations: rap on the door with your knuckles

senses.en: a joint of meat containing a bone, such as a knuckle of pork or lamb

example.en: She bought a knuckle of lamb for the stew.
example.zh: 她买了一个羊肘来炖汤。

senses.en: to press, rub or hit something with your knuckles
senses.zh: 用指节敲打（或按压、揉擦）

example.en: He knuckled the dough on the counter.
example.zh: 他在案板上用指节揉面团。

senses.en: relating to the sun

example.en: The solar system includes Earth and seven other planets.
example.zh: 太阳系包括地球和其他七颗行星。

senses.en: using energy from the sun

example.en: They installed solar panels on the roof.
example.zh: 他们在屋顶安装了太阳能板。

senses.en: to show that something is right or reasonable by giving reasons or evidence

example.en: She had to justify her decision to the committee.
example.zh: 她不得不向委员会证明她的决定是合理的。

senses.en: to arrange text so that the left and right edges line up

example.en: The report looks neater when you justify the text.
example.zh: 把文本两端对齐后，报告看起来更整齐。

senses.en: the act of reaching a place

example.en: We waited for the arrival of the train.
example.zh: 我们等待火车的到达。

senses.en: a person or thing that has arrived

example.en: The new arrival was greeted by the whole family.
example.zh: 新到来的人受到了全家的欢迎。

senses.en: special skill or knowledge gained from training and experience

example.en: Her expertise in finance helped the company avoid costly mistakes.
example.zh: 她在金融方面的专业知识帮助公司避免了代价高昂的错误。

senses.en: to cause a person, animal, or plant to die

example.en: The frost killed the young plants overnight.
example.zh: 霜冻一夜之间冻死了幼苗。

senses.en: to end or stop something from continuing

example.en: The company killed the project after a review.
example.zh: 公司在审查后终止了这个项目。

senses.en: an act of killing, especially an animal hunted for food or sport

example.en: The hunter made a clean kill.
example.zh: 猎人干净利落地捕杀了一只猎物。

senses.en: a personal opinion or way of thinking about something

example.en: In my view, the plan needs more time.
example.zh: 在我看来，这个计划需要更多时间。

senses.en: what can be seen from a particular place, especially attractive scenery

example.en: The room has a fine view of the lake.
example.zh: 这个房间可以看到美丽的湖景。

senses.en: to think about someone or something in a particular way

example.en: Many people view the change as an opportunity.
example.zh: 许多人把这一变化视为机遇。

senses.en: to look at or watch something

example.en: You can view the photos on the website.
example.zh: 你可以在网站上查看这些照片。

senses.en: to make something better

example.en: Regular practice can improve your writing.
example.zh: 经常练习可以提高你的写作水平。

senses.en: to become better

example.en: Her health began to improve after some rest.
example.zh: 休息之后，她的健康开始好转。

senses.en: the degree to which something is true, serious, or large

example.en: The report describes the extent of the damage.
example.zh: 这份报告描述了损坏的程度。

senses.en: the area or range over which something extends

example.en: The map shows the full extent of the national park.
example.zh: 地图显示了国家公园的完整范围。

senses.en: a hole or empty space that is not closed or filled

example.en: Light came through a small opening in the curtain.
example.zh: 光线从窗帘上的一个小开口透进来。

senses.en: the act or ceremony of starting something

example.en: We attended the opening of the new library.
example.zh: 我们参加了新图书馆的开幕式。

senses.en: first or beginning

example.en: Her opening remarks were brief and clear.
example.zh: 她的开场发言简短明了。

senses.en: the solid base of a building that it stands on

example.en: The flood damaged the foundations of the house.
example.zh: 洪水损坏了这座房子的地基。

senses.en: the basis on which something is built or supported

example.en: Trust is the foundation of a good friendship.
example.zh: 信任是良好友谊的基础。

senses.en: an organization supported by donated money

example.en: The foundation funds medical research.
example.zh: 该基金会资助医学研究。

senses.en: a skin-colored cream worn on the face

example.en: She applied foundation before the interview.
example.zh: 她在面试前涂了粉底。

senses.en: a serious infectious disease that usually affects the lungs, caused by bacteria and spread through the air

example.en: The clinic screens patients for tuberculosis.
example.zh: 这家诊所为患者进行结核病筛查。

senses.en: the act of winding or twisting something

example.en: The winding of the cable took a few minutes.
example.zh: 卷绕电缆花了几分钟。

senses.en: a coil of wire, especially in an electrical machine

example.en: A damaged winding can cause the motor to fail.
example.zh: 线圈损坏会导致电机失灵。

senses.en: twisting and turning repeatedly, as a road or path

example.en: They drove along a winding mountain road.
example.zh: 他们沿着蜿蜒的山路行驶。

senses.en: operated by or using pressurized liquid such as water or oil

example.en: The excavator uses a hydraulic system to lift heavy loads.
example.zh: 这台挖掘机使用液压系统来吊起重物。

senses.en: relating to the science of water flow and fluid mechanics

example.en: Engineers studied the hydraulic properties of the new dam.
example.zh: 工程师们研究了新大坝的水力学特性。

senses.en: to bring power, control, or activities together at one central point

example.en: The government decided to centralize control of the schools.
example.zh: 政府决定将学校的管理权集中起来。

senses.en: to move data, services, or functions to a single central place
senses.zh: 把（数据、服务等）集中于中心

example.en: The company centralized all its records in one database.
example.zh: 这家公司把所有记录集中到一个数据库中。

senses.en: within the shortest distance

example.en: Sit with whoever is sitting closest to the door.
example.zh: 坐在离门最近的人旁边。

senses.en: nearest in distance, relationship, or similarity

example.en: She is my closest friend.
example.zh: 她是我最亲密的朋友。

senses.en: the state of being mortal; the fact that people must eventually die
senses.zh: 必死性；终有一死的命运

example.en: The diagnosis made him confront his own mortality.
example.zh: 这个诊断让他直面自己终有一死的命运。

senses.en: the number of deaths in a population, often given as a rate

example.en: Infant mortality has fallen sharply over the past decade.
example.zh: 过去十年婴儿死亡率大幅下降。

senses.en: a clear sign or display of something

example.en: Anger is one manifestation of stress.
example.zh: 愤怒是压力的一种表现。

senses.en: a simple repeated word, phrase or song, often sung by a group

example.en: The crowd performed a loud chant during the match.
example.zh: 比赛期间人群大声呼喊口号。

senses.en: to sing or shout words repeatedly, often with a rhythm

example.en: The fans chanted the team's name all evening.
example.zh: 球迷整晚反复呼喊球队的名字。

senses.en: a type of religious song with a simple melody

example.en: The monks sang a Gregorian chant in the chapel.
example.zh: 修士们在小教堂里唱格里高利圣咏。

senses.en: to stop or catch something moving from one place to another

example.en: The police intercepted the package before it was delivered.
example.zh: 警方在包裹送达之前将其截获。

senses.en: the point where a line crosses a coordinate axis

example.en: The line has a y-intercept of three.
example.zh: 这条直线的y轴截距是三。

senses.en: happening at the end, after a period of time

example.en: The eventual winner of the election was announced two days later.
example.zh: 选举的最终获胜者两天后宣布了。

senses.en: a common English surname

example.en: Mr. Johnson is our new English teacher.
example.zh: 约翰逊先生是我们的新英语老师。

senses.en: to make something available for sale, often sacrificing quality for profit

example.en: Critics say the festival has become too commercialized.
example.zh: 批评人士说这个节日已经变得过于商业化。

senses.en: not embarrassed or ashamed about something

example.en: He was unabashed about singing badly in public.
example.zh: 他对自己在公众场合唱歌跑调毫不害臊。

senses.en: relating to or characterized by imitation

example.en: Some insects show mimetic coloring to resemble leaves.
example.zh: 有些昆虫表现出模仿性的颜色，形似树叶。

senses.en: an unusual habit or way of behaving that is typical of one person

example.en: One of his idiosyncrasies is drinking tea only from a specific cup.
example.zh: 他的怪癖之一是只用一个特定的杯子喝茶。

senses.en: a guard or someone keeping watch

example.en: A sentinel stood at the gate all night.
example.zh: 一名哨兵整夜守在大门口。

senses.en: producing a feeling of calm and rest

example.en: We spent a restful weekend in the countryside.
example.zh: 我们在乡间度过了一个宁静的周末。

senses.en: a sudden painful tightening of a muscle

example.en: She got a cramp in her leg while swimming.
example.zh: 她游泳时腿部抽筋了。

senses.en: to restrict or hinder movement or activity

example.en: Fear of failure cramped his creativity.
example.zh: 对失败的恐惧束缚了他的创造力。

senses.en: the finger next to the thumb; index finger

example.en: She pointed at the map with her forefinger.
example.zh: 她用食指指着地图。

senses.en: a blunt refusal of a request or offer

example.en: His proposal met with a firm rebuff from the board.
example.zh: 他的提议遭到董事会的断然拒绝。

senses.en: to reject someone or something bluntly

example.en: She rebuffed his offer of help politely but firmly.
example.zh: 她礼貌而坚决地回绝了他提供的帮助。

senses.en: an activity or trend that becomes popular and attracts growing support

example.en: Many companies jumped on the electric car bandwagon.
example.zh: 许多公司一窝蜂地加入了电动汽车的潮流。

senses.en: lacking power or ability to act
senses.zh: 无能为力的；软弱无效的

example.en: The committee felt impotent in the face of the crisis.
example.zh: 面对危机，委员会感到无能为力。

senses.en: unable to have sexual intercourse (medical, of a man)

example.en: The condition can leave a man impotent.
example.zh: 这种病症可能导致男性性无能。

senses.en: a violent uprising against an authority or government

example.en: The government quickly put down the insurrection.
example.zh: 政府迅速平息了这场暴动。

senses.en: a person whose job is to carry out official executions

example.en: In medieval times the executioner wore a hood.
example.zh: 在中世纪，刽子手戴着兜帽。

senses.en: able to be moved from one place to another

example.en: The shelves are movable, so you can rearrange the room.
example.zh: 架子是可移动的，所以你可以重新布置房间。

senses.en: (law) property that can be moved, as opposed to land or buildings

example.en: Furniture and vehicles count as movables under the law.
example.zh: 家具和车辆在法律上属于动产。

senses.en: strong trust or confidence in someone or something
senses.zh: 对某人或某物的强烈信任或信心

example.en: She has great faith in her team.
example.zh: 她对她的团队非常有信心。

senses.en: belief in a religion or in God

example.en: His faith gives him strength during hard times.
example.zh: 他的信仰在困难时期给了他力量。

senses.en: a particular religion or system of religious belief
senses.zh: 某一特定宗教或宗教信仰体系

example.en: People of different faiths attended the meeting.
example.zh: 不同信仰的人参加了这次会议。

senses.en: something kept hidden from other people

example.en: She kept the plan a secret.
example.zh: 她把这个计划保密了。

senses.en: known or seen by only a few people

example.en: The door has a secret compartment.
example.zh: 这扇门有一个隐秘的隔层。

senses.en: for what reason

example.en: Why did you choose this route?
example.zh: 你为什么选择这条路线？

senses.en: the reason or purpose for something

example.en: She never explained the why behind her decision.
example.zh: 她从未解释自己决定背后的原因。

senses.en: used to show surprise, agreement, or mild protest
senses.zh: 哎呀；咦；当然啦（表示惊讶、同意或轻微抗议）

example.en: Why, I didn't know you were coming!
example.zh: 哎呀，我不知道你要来！

senses.en: a road vehicle with four wheels that carries a small number of people

example.en: She parked the car outside the bakery.
example.zh: 她把车停在面包店外面。

senses.en: a separate vehicle that is part of a train

example.en: The last car of the train was empty.
example.zh: 火车的最后一节车厢是空的。

senses.en: the part of an elevator that carries people or goods

example.en: The elevator car stopped between floors.
example.zh: 电梯轿厢停在了楼层之间。

senses.en: a path or course used by people, animals, or vehicles, including a route for racing

example.en: We followed a muddy track through the woods.
example.zh: 我们沿着一条泥泞的小路穿过树林。

senses.en: a railway line or the rails on it

example.en: The train stopped on the wrong track.
example.zh: 火车停在了错误的轨道上。

senses.en: a song or piece of recorded music

example.en: The title track is my favorite song on the album.
example.zh: 专辑同名曲是我在这张专辑里最喜欢的歌。

senses.en: to follow or observe someone or something

example.en: The app lets you track your daily spending.
example.zh: 这个应用可以让你追踪日常开支。

senses.en: the act of changing or improving something by reviewing and correcting it

example.en: The report needs a thorough revision before publication.
example.zh: 这份报告在发表前需要全面修订。

senses.en: a new version of something that has been revised

example.en: This is the second revision of the manual.
example.zh: 这是手册的第二修订版。

senses.en: (British English) the process of studying work again before an exam

example.en: She is doing revision for her exams next week.
example.zh: 她正在为下周的考试做复习。

senses.en: a long narrow band of color different from the surface around it

example.en: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
example.zh: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。

senses.en: a band on a uniform showing military rank or length of service
senses.zh: （军服上的）军衔或服役年限杠

example.en: He earned another stripe after five years of service.
example.zh: 服役五年后他又添了一道杠。

senses.en: to mark something with stripes

example.en: The workers striped the parking lot with fresh white paint.
example.zh: 工人们用白色新漆给停车场划线。

senses.en: to take control of a country or people by force

example.en: The army conquered the region after a long war.
example.zh: 军队经过长期战争征服了该地区。

senses.en: to defeat an opponent or overcome a difficulty or fear

example.en: She finally conquered her fear of public speaking.
example.zh: 她终于克服了对公开演讲的恐惧。

senses.en: a woman who has authority, control, or ownership; the female head of a household

example.en: The servants obeyed the mistress of the house.
example.zh: 仆人们听从这家女主人的吩咐。

senses.en: a woman having a sexual relationship with a married man

example.en: Rumors spread that the duke kept a mistress in the city.
example.zh: 谣言传开，说公爵在城里养了个情妇。

senses.en: a woman regarded as skilled or outstanding in a field
senses.zh: 能手；名家（常用于短语 mistress of）

example.en: She is a mistress of the art of negotiation.
example.zh: 她是谈判艺术的高手。

senses.en: (British, dated) a woman schoolteacher

example.en: The new school mistress kept the class very quiet.
example.zh: 新来的女教师让全班非常安静。

senses.en: peaceful and free from excitement, strong wind, or trouble

example.en: The sea was calm in the early morning.
example.zh: 清晨海面很平静。

senses.en: a peaceful, quiet state without strong wind or worry

example.en: There was a sudden calm before the storm.
example.zh: 暴风雨来临前一片平静。

senses.en: to make someone or something peaceful and quiet

example.en: She calmed the crying child with a gentle song.
example.zh: 她用轻柔的歌声安抚哭闹的孩子。

senses.en: causing great sadness, often involving death or disaster

example.en: The fire had tragic consequences for the whole family.
example.zh: 这场火灾给全家带来了悲惨的后果。

senses.en: relating to tragedy as a form of drama or literature

example.en: Hamlet is one of Shakespeare's most famous tragic heroes.
example.zh: 哈姆雷特是莎士比亚最著名的悲剧英雄之一。

senses.en: a state of agreement or peaceful coexistence

example.en: The family lives in harmony.
example.zh: 这个家庭生活得很融洽。

senses.en: pleasant combinations of musical notes played or sung together

example.en: They sang the song in perfect harmony.
example.zh: 他们唱这首歌时和声非常完美。

senses.en: to prevent someone's plans or efforts from succeeding

example.en: The bad weather frustrated our plans for a picnic.
example.zh: 坏天气破坏了我们野餐的计划。

senses.en: to make someone feel annoyed because they cannot achieve what they want

example.en: It frustrates me when the internet is too slow to load.
example.zh: 网速太慢打不开时，我感到很懊恼。

senses.en: to lean or slope to one side

example.en: The picture on the wall tilted to the left.
example.zh: 墙上的画向左倾斜了。

senses.en: an act of leaning or sloping to one side

example.en: The tilt of the floor made the furniture slide.
example.zh: 地板的倾斜使家具滑动。

senses.en: to cause a contest or situation to favor one side

example.en: New evidence tilted the argument in their favor.
example.zh: 新证据使争论的形势偏向他们。

senses.en: a long formal dress, especially one worn by women on formal occasions

example.en: She wore an elegant black gown to the ball.
example.zh: 她穿着一件优雅的黑色礼服去参加舞会。

senses.en: a loose protective garment worn by doctors, patients, or graduates

example.en: The surgeon put on a sterile gown before the operation.
example.zh: 外科医生在手术前穿上了无菌手术衣。

senses.en: to dress someone in a gown

example.en: The nurse gowned the patient before surgery.
example.zh: 护士在手术前给病人穿上了罩衣。

senses.en: a practice session in preparation for a public performance

example.en: The cast attended a final rehearsal before opening night.
example.zh: 全体演员在首演前参加了最后一次排练。

senses.en: the act of repeating information silently or aloud to remember it
senses.zh: 复述（心理学术语，指反复默念或说出信息以帮助记忆）

example.en: Repeating a phone number aloud is a form of rehearsal.
example.zh: 大声重复电话号码是一种复述。

senses.en: a situation where things are not equal or balanced

example.en: There is an imbalance between work and rest in his daily life.
example.zh: 他的日常生活中工作与休息不平衡。

senses.en: a small pool of water on the ground

example.en: The children jumped over the puddle after the rain.
example.zh: 雨后孩子们跳过水坑。

senses.en: to splash or play in water

example.en: Toddlers love puddling in rain pools.
example.zh: 幼儿喜欢在水洼里玩耍。

senses.en: organized so that parts work together effectively

example.en: The rescue effort was well coordinated.
example.zh: 这次救援行动组织得非常协调。

senses.en: able to move different body parts smoothly together

example.en: She is very coordinated and excels at dance.
example.zh: 她身体协调性很好，舞蹈很出色。

senses.en: in an eager and excited way

example.en: The students enthusiastically joined the discussion.
example.zh: 学生们热情地参与了讨论。

senses.en: to secretly enter an organization or place to gain information or influence

example.en: Spies infiltrated the enemy's intelligence agency.
example.zh: 间谍渗透进了敌方情报机构。

senses.en: to pass into or through a substance, especially a liquid or gas

example.en: Water infiltrated the soil after the heavy rain.
example.zh: 大雨后水渗入了土壤。

senses.en: able to be recognized or identified

example.en: The suspect was easily identifiable from the security footage.
example.zh: 从监控录像中很容易辨认出这名嫌疑人。

senses.en: able to hold a lot; having large capacity

example.en: She packed everything into her capacious bag.
example.zh: 她把所有东西都装进了她那个大容量的包里。

senses.en: to make things the same or uniform by mixing

example.en: The machine homogenizes the milk so the cream does not separate.
example.zh: 这台机器把牛奶均质化，使奶油不会分离。

senses.en: to carry pollen to a plant so it can produce seeds or fruit

example.en: Bees pollinate the apple blossoms every spring.
example.zh: 蜜蜂每年春天为苹果花授粉。

senses.en: a flat closed shape with straight sides

example.en: A triangle is a polygon with three sides.
example.zh: 三角形是有三条边的多边形。

senses.en: able to bend and move easily and gracefully

example.en: The dancer kept her body supple through daily stretching.
example.zh: 这位舞者通过每天拉伸保持身体柔软。

senses.en: able to adapt or change easily; flexible in character

example.en: The company has a supple management style.
example.zh: 这家公司的管理风格灵活多变。

senses.en: done without a good reason; unnecessary

example.en: The film was criticized for its gratuitous violence.
example.zh: 这部电影因无端展现暴力而受到批评。

senses.en: given or provided free of charge

example.en: The charity provides gratuitous legal advice to low-income families.
example.zh: 该慈善机构为低收入家庭提供免费法律咨询。

senses.en: a pair of photographs taken from slightly different angles that gives a 3D effect when viewed together

example.en: The museum displayed a collection of old stereophotographs.
example.zh: 博物馆展出了一组旧立体照片。

senses.en: the state of being healthy, happy, and comfortable

example.en: Regular exercise improves your physical and mental well-being.
example.zh: 经常锻炼能改善你的身心健康。
